notes.title: Town of illustive - Special Demo Version 1.2 Release Now a DLC too...
notes.content:
[p]We have now released Version 1.2 For Town of illustive: Special Demo Version as well released a special[/p][p]Free DLC to play the demo version of the game if you already owned town of illustive.   Make sure you select "Launch Helper Network Launcher (Beta)" To run the brand new episode launcher.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793747/a2ea1a1936faf8207d9448082ec98a8324ca72aa.png"][/img][/p][p]

notes.title: 1.2 Improvements update
notes.content:
[p]

As part of the major changes to the current storywriting improvements of town of illustive as well introducing to the world of the future helper series, we are updating and releasing a new version including graphical and important bug fixes on both the demo version and episode 1 prior to Episode 2 release.[/p][p][/p][p]As well the retiring the old Episodic launcher software in favor for a newer and sleeker Platform Friendly Launcher.[/p][p][/p][p]Planned changes:[/p][olist][*][p]Changes to puzzles graphics and text to make puzzler easier to understand.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to some maps looks. No changes to layout of current maps designs.[/p][/*][*][p]inclusion of pre-rendered 3D introduction character models that have been designed for the future helper franchise.[/p][/*][*][p]further improvements of dialogue and scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Replacement of the current episodic launcher with a more powerful Launcher dubbed The "Helper Network Service" a platform independent and friendly launcher for all Future Helper series games.[/p][/*][/olist][p]We would like to thank to all of our players for being part of the community[/p]

notes.content: - Fix certain room becoming accessible too early.

notes.title: Episode 1 (Base game set) NOW OUT!
notes.content:
Town of illustive Episode 1 is now out. Enjoy the adventure of Jenet, Alan, Thomas and Jeff. As they search through the house near the mysterious town that only appeared on Halloween night.

All Current and future base game purchases include Episode 2: The loop Which will be release as a standalone FREE DLC update in the near future.

notes.title: Game almost ready
notes.content:
Hello and we welcome you to the community.

MJM Creative works and Ideas is almost ready for the release of the first episode of town of illustive. And completing the episode pre-launch checking. Once pre-launch checks are done and conducted, the game will be released.

And don't forget all Base game purchase includes both Episode 1 and 2 (Episode 2 will be release at a later date)
As more episode is release in the coming months additional content may added to previous episodes post-release.

further bug fixes maybe conducted at any point in time,

notes.title: Town of illustive @ E-Sport and Gaming Summit 2023
notes.content:
Town of illustive will be at the E-sport and gaming summit this coming November 3 - 5 at the World trade center in Pasay city, Philippines.

Try out the Special demo version and Episode 1 that will be available at the event.

For more info about E-sport and Gaming Summit visit: https://www.facebook.com/ESGSPhilippines/

notes.title: Bug Fixes - Special Demo version
notes.content:
Were sending a bug fix for the town of illustive - Special Demo version.

Changes:
- Fixed Episodic Game launcher not launching the game properly on certain devices.
- Fixed the game executable not launching the game properly on certain devices.

were apologized for the inconvenience. but rest assured the fixes have been tested prior to the update.
